_note: Adversary pool — AI-only, never collectible (Law 2). Stats for the 9 'already-defined' villains (Goliath..The Serpent) are drafted to the stat rail and need a balance-sim review; the 13 from docs/08 use the doc's values.

adversaries.name: Goliath of Gath
adversaries.text: Guard.
adversaries.flavor: Nine feet of contempt. Nobody volunteered. Then a boy did. — 1 Samuel 17.
adversaries.art: A towering armored Philistine champion with a massive spear, sneering down from the height, cold bronze and shadow.

adversaries.name: Egyptian Taskmaster
adversaries.text: Arrival: an enemy unit gets -1 attack this turn.
adversaries.flavor: Quota's the quota. Make bricks without straw. — Exodus 5.
adversaries.art: A whip-coiled overseer glowering over brick-pits, hard-eyed, dust and cold gold.

adversaries.name: Philistine Soldier
adversaries.flavor: One of thousands. Confident, right up until the sling.
adversaries.art: A helmeted Philistine warrior with round shield and short sword, iron and crest-feathers, cold light.

adversaries.name: Amalekite Raider
adversaries.text: Swift.
adversaries.flavor: Struck the stragglers at the back. Cowardly and quick. — Deuteronomy 25.
adversaries.art: A desert raider mid-charge on a lean horse, wrapped face, scavenger menace, dusk.

adversaries.name: Chariot of Iron
adversaries.text: Guard.
adversaries.flavor: They had iron chariots, so the valley stayed unconquered. For a while. — Judges 1.
adversaries.art: A bristling iron war-chariot with scythed wheels, drawn by armored horses, cold and grinding.

adversaries.name: Jezebel
adversaries.text: Arrival: silence an enemy unit and give it -2 attack.
adversaries.flavor: Painted her eyes and looked out the window to the very end. — 2 Kings 9.
adversaries.art: A cold, regal queen at a high window, kohl-lined eyes, ornate and merciless, deep shadow.

adversaries.name: Pharaoh's Magician
adversaries.text: Arrival: summon a 1/1 Serpent.
adversaries.flavor: Matched the first few signs. Then the staff ate theirs. — Exodus 7.
adversaries.art: A court sorcerer with a staff twisting into a snake, painted eyes, cold torchlit chamber.

adversaries.name: Idol of Ba'al
adversaries.text: Standing. At the end of the AI's turn, give a random Adversary +1/+0.
adversaries.flavor: They shouted from morning till noon. Nobody answered. — 1 Kings 18.
adversaries.art: A looming bronze idol on a stone altar, cold and lifeless, hollow eyes, smoke curling unanswered.

adversaries.name: The Serpent
adversaries.text: Arrival: an enemy unit's text is removed. (Did God really say...?)
adversaries.flavor: The subtlest of all. Asked a question that wasn't really a question. — Genesis 3.
adversaries.art: A great coiling serpent among shadowed garden branches, gleaming scales and a cold knowing eye — sinister, never comic.

adversaries.name: Pharaoh, the Hardened
adversaries.text: Arrival: enemy units can't attack next turn (his heart hardens).
adversaries.flavor: Ten warnings. He kept every one of them. — Exodus.
adversaries.art: An enthroned king of Egypt, arms crossed, cold gold and lapis, a river of shadow behind.

adversaries.name: Haman the Agagite
adversaries.text: Legacy: the gallows he built fall on the strongest enemy unit.
adversaries.flavor: Built a very tall gallows. Should have measured twice. — Esther 7.
adversaries.art: A sneering vizier beside an enormous empty gallows, torchlight, dread irony.

adversaries.name: Nebuchadnezzar
adversaries.text: Arrival: bow or burn — deal 3 to all enemy units without Guard.
adversaries.flavor: Built a golden statue and a furnace to match. Three men declined. — Daniel 3.
adversaries.art: A colossal golden statue with a king enthroned before it, furnace-glow, cold pride.

adversaries.name: Herod
adversaries.text: Arrival: destroy the enemy's cheapest unit.
adversaries.flavor: Paranoid on a too-large throne. Feared a child. — Matthew 2.
adversaries.art: A paranoid king on an oversized throne, soldiers in shadow, cold marble and gold.

adversaries.name: Sennacherib's Host
adversaries.text: Arrival: summon two 2/2 Assyrian Soldiers.
adversaries.flavor: A vast army camped outside the walls. By morning, quiet. — 2 Kings 19.
adversaries.art: A vast siege camp bristling with spears outside a walled city at dusk, cold and countless.

adversaries.name: Delilah
adversaries.text: Arrival: an enemy unit loses its keywords and gets -2 attack.
adversaries.flavor: Asked the same question four times. He finally answered. — Judges 16.
adversaries.art: An elegant figure with shears, a sleeping strongman's silhouette, candlelit betrayal.

adversaries.name: Absalom
adversaries.text: Swift. Legacy: deal 2 to the enemy hero.
adversaries.flavor: Stole hearts at the gate. Undone by his own hair. — 2 Samuel 18.
adversaries.art: A proud prince on a mule beneath a great oak, long hair, storm light, cold beauty.

adversaries.name: Sisera
adversaries.text: Guard.
adversaries.flavor: Nine hundred chariots. Undone by a tent peg and a woman named Jael. — Judges 4.
adversaries.art: An iron-chariot commander surveying a plain, bronze and cruelty, cold dusk.

adversaries.name: The Witch of Endor
adversaries.text: Arrival: return a fallen Adversary from the discard.
adversaries.flavor: The king who banned mediums came looking for one by night. — 1 Samuel 28.
adversaries.art: A dim cave, a hooded figure over a guttering fire, cold blue smoke, dread.

adversaries.name: Sanballat & Tobiah
adversaries.text: Arrival: an enemy relic costs (2) more to activate.
adversaries.flavor: Mocked the builders. The wall went up in fifty-two days anyway. — Nehemiah 6.
adversaries.art: Two mocking officials pointing at a half-built wall, sneers, dusty ridge, cold light.

adversaries.name: Leviathan
adversaries.text: Guard. Takes no damage from spells.
adversaries.flavor: Can you draw him out with a hook? No. — Job 41.
adversaries.art: A vast sea-serpent coiling through black water, moonlight on scales — awe, not gore.

adversaries.name: Behemoth
adversaries.text: Endure.
adversaries.flavor: He eats grass like an ox and fears nothing. — Job 40.
adversaries.art: An enormous beast at a marsh's edge, cedar-strong, dawn mist, immense and calm.

adversaries.name: The Golden Calf
adversaries.text: Standing. At the end of the AI's turn, give a random Adversary +1/+1.
adversaries.flavor: Made a god from earrings while the mountain still smoked. — Exodus 32.
adversaries.art: A gilded calf idol on a pedestal, revelers' shadows, firelight, cold and hollow.
